QuestInfo.name: Blue Material's Identity
QuestInfo.1: The Dark Stone Golem Rubble did not contain the blue material. Dr. Bruce thinks the substance might be Blue Mushmom Spores, and he suspects that these spores might have some kind of mysterious power. He asked you to collect 3 Blue Mushmom Spores and take them to Pia, who knows a lot about mushrooms and magic.\n
QuestInfo.2: You collected 3 Blue Mushmom Spores, and took them to Pia for her take on what these spores can do.\n
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 700 #Wbasic# #i1082017:# #t1082017:# x 1 Can proceed to The Mixed Golem Threat quest

0.0: Weird! The burning has stopped, but there was no goo inside those Dark Stone Golem Rubbles! It is a mystery. A SCIENCE mystery! My research has turned up a little bit more about what I was calling nano-jam. I now believe it to be a concentrate of Blue Mushmom Spores! Hence the whole poisoning myself thing.
0.1: Unlocking the secrets of Golem creation would be the greatest discovery of the century! We just need to find an expert on magic. And mushrooms. But not magic mushrooms. One of those things turned my cat into a toaster, literally.

yes.0: Take 3 Blue Mushmom Spores over to Pia. I know, I know, she looks like she'd be dumber than a rock, but boy does she know her mushrooms. She lives over on the west side of town, but she's probably playing with sticks over by Rina's house.

no.0: But, there is science to be done! I knew I should have given this job to that evil robot lady.

1.0: Look at this stick guy! I made him myself!!\r\n#L0##b That's...wonderful. Dr. Bruce sent me over to ask about Blue Mushmom Spores. Do you think they have the power to make golems come to life?#l\n#k
1.1: Golem is a funny word! Oh! Pretty blue thing! Gimme!

yes.0: No way, this stuff is pretty but Blue Mushmom Spores don't have no special powers! They're just spores! They float all around and stick to things and then they grow more mushrooms! Dr. Bruce must be eating a lot of these if he thinks they can make things move on their own. You should go talk to Rina. She uses all kinds of funny words, just like you! I think she's usually over at that temple, the Golem's Temple, on nights where the moon is big.
